sections.executive_summary: Paper learning is still underwater versus ^FTSE after costs: primary **ai_judgment** excess is **−34.47%** versus benchmark **−1.98%** (`beat_market`: false), though it still beats the **rules** control (**−41.67%**). **Momentum_grace** is the best of the three named books on excess (**−6.61%**) with much lower cost drag (**10.4%** vs **40.7%** primary), but experiment_assessment marks that track **fail** on forward gates. Archived signal work (23 runs) still shows modest **buy**/**hold** 7d excess, which has not translated into paper alpha. The largest modelling gap this week is **1w assessment calibration**: trajectory_evidence lists **hold→buy** at **28.6%** positive rate (**n=42**, mean **−1.04%**) and **1w hit_rate 35.1%** (**n=827**), aligned with **garp** (**12**) and **quality**/**dividend** failures in **72** loser_snapshot_cards — assessment timing/conviction, not live-screen churn.

sections.signal_backtest_findings:
- **Archived backtest** (`run_count` **23**, not seeding): strongest cited horizons — **buy** 7d excess **+1.53%** (n=1002); **buy** 28d **+1.36%** (n=594); **hold** 7d **+0.91%** (n=3087); **avoid** 7d **+1.04%** (n=982); **hold**/**avoid** 28d negative excess vs benchmark.
- **Historical analysis** (`run_count` **23**, 9 observation weeks): **overlay:strong_buy** 7d smoothed excess **+2.68%** (n=192); **overlay:buy** 7d smoothed **+0.28%**; 28d smoothed screen/overlay excess both negative — short-horizon signal edge, longer-horizon decay.
- **Offline simulation** (23 periods): **static_levels** / **trailing_levels** excess **+0.94%** vs benchmark **−3.74%** with **7** trades; **research_overlay** excess **−31.49%** with **122** trades — turnover/cost story matches paper books.
- **trajectory_evidence:** `labeled_event_count` **1086**; hit rates **1w 35.1%** (827) → **12w 52.9%** (340); `weeks_to_realization` median **2.0** weeks, **within_4w_rate 81.5%**, **realized_within_12w_rate 72.2%**. Model-focus (assessment hypotheses only): **hold→buy** 1w — flip did not match next-week price; **signal_unchanged** 1w weak directionality; **avoid→hold**, **strong_buy→buy**, **buy→strong_buy** similar; **1w horizon_hit_rate** below chance at short horizon.
- **loser_snapshot_cards:** **card_count 72**; cohorts **avoid 54**, **failed_buy_alumni 21**; **top_failed_families:** **garp 12**, **dividend 10**, **quality 9**, **risk 3**, **cheapness 3** — e.g. **BBY.L** failed_buy_alumni with **cheapness/dividend/garp** and “passes cheapness family (currently failed)” flip trigger.
- **chart_outcome_review (observe-only):** verdict **has_terrible** — **74 terrible**, **5 stop_hit**, **168 well_timed** / **1107** charts; well-timed example **RWS.L** (+71.5%); weakest **LNZ.VI** (−39.7%). **921** missing_initial_levels limits timing trust.
- **exclusion_universe:** `readiness.ready_for_priors` **true** (22 week-pairs); **recommended_step u2** (“Exclude avoid + timing wait”) **cumulative_exclusion_alpha −0.000828** (best among pool≥15 constraints; **u5** **+0.008004** on ladder but not recommended).

2. **[scoring] GARP + quality/dividend gate stress on avoid & failed_buy_alumni — expected learning value:** Replay family weights using **garp**-heavy loser cards (e.g. **AAL.L** / **BBY.L** flip patterns); human ack pending on **ana-20260921-02**.
3. **[paper_knobs] Human-run exclusion-ladder shadow spawn (step u2) — expected learning value:** With `ready_for_shadow_spawn` true and **+4.51%** replay delta, run **ftse-exclusion-ladder-replay spawn-shadow** and observe forward vs parent (not auto-spawn).
4. **[paper_churn] Archive-informed swap vs hold prior — expected learning value:** Use near_miss swap **60.4%** replacement win (550 closed) vs hold **73.3%** recovery as offline_sim prior while live rules hold **11** / swap **0**; human ack **ana-20260921-04**; cite reconciliation (no blended live/archive rates).
5. **[paper_churn] Calibrated-shadow selection review (quality loser skew) — expected learning value:** Test thesis-preserving rotation rules when **within_tolerance false** and **quality fails more often among losers** on calibrated shadows — **balancing_hint hold_intact_review_selection**, not mark stops.
